basic_info.description: On a desirable wide corner lot on a tree-lined street in Presidio Heights, this timeless four-bedroom residence catches the eye with its unique silhouette and offers ideal spaces for living and entertaining. Bay windows and decks on all levels allow for appreciation of the rarefied setting and views that stretch to the Golden Gate. Flanking the foyer are formal living and dining rooms, each with a bay window and a fireplace. Nearby is a kitchen with a wall of windows and a sunny breakfast area with French doors opening to a wraparound deck and access to the garden below. The garden is enveloped by landscaping and features a charming brick patio. The bedroom level boasts three bedrooms and three baths, including the principal suite which includes French doors to a walk-out deck and an elegant bath. A cheerful auxiliary suite features a fireplace and a bath accented by vibrant vintage tile. On the uppermost level are a peaceful bedroom, full bath, and a pentroom with views of the Presidio and Golden Gate Bridge and access to the walk-out deck. The lowest level offers a laundry room, an office with an ensuite bath, a workshop, and a spacious one-car garage. The lush green expanse of the Presidio as well as the restaurants and shops of Sacramento Street and Laurel Village are nearby.
